title: Parent SonarQube quality gate remains failed pending authorized review of three validated-safe hotspots
title_de: Parent-SonarQube-Quality-Gate bleibt bis zur autorisierten Prüfung von drei validiert sicheren Hotspots fehlgeschlagen
summary: Current Parent master 5b8db00d44ab24f3a9f4216a00f7edee977b6898 is the protected squash result of PR #99. Its resulting-master SonarCloud check 89321542088 has Quality Gate ERROR: new reliability and maintainability ratings are 1 and new-code duplication is 0.4%, but new security rating is 5 and hotspot review is 0.0%. It has three TO_REVIEW hotspots. Exact-master source/control/sink validation classifies all three remaining S5332 hotspots as already_safe policy detector data; an authorized external reviewed/safe disposition is the only bounded remaining Quality-Gate action. Ten separate current regular Vulnerability rows were independently triaged as not_actionable with no source change required: four python:S5332 rows, five pythonsecurity:S2083 rows, and one python:S5443 test-only secure-temporary-directory row. Two current pythonsecurity:S8707 rows now have locally validated source repairs: the response-header backend validates fixture reads through the existing safe-root, regular-file, and symlink-resolving containment control before Path.read_text, and the Lighttpd HTTP/1.1 entity fixture helper validates ready/result output files beneath --safe-root while publishing JSON through exclusive randomized same-directory staging. The ten not_actionable rows remain OPEN without an external false-positive disposition; both S8707 issues remain OPEN on master until a delivered head is analyzed. This local work covers twelve exact inventory rows and leaves 194 Parent Vulnerability rows untriaged. Sonar indexes Framework and nested MRTS paths, tracked in FND-SONAR-0004, so the project aggregate does not prove Parent-only gate causality.
